expires_today.title: The Factory Must Grow
expires_today.long_description:
The factories are open for business. This construction-focused bundle offers builder-style games with a wide range of flavors, ranging from complex space expeditions to cozy, relaxing island sims. Strap on your helmet for Eden Crafters, the ultimate open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform far-off planets into close-knit communities; terraform a dying planet back to health in Blossom: The Seed of Life; or try Oddsparks for a unique blend of automation and real-time strategy! Pay what you want for great games and help support TD Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Java by Apress
expires_today.description: Find your groove with Java by Apress.
expires_today.long_description: Level up your tech skills before fall takes form with our latest Java Mastery Bundle by Apress. Flip the script on your job prospects and learn how to speak standard languages used by computer experts, create efficient agentic assistants, and more with approachable lessons like Pro Spring Boot 4: An Authoritative Guide with Best Practices and Go for Java Programmers: Learn Google's Go Programming Language. Start a new career in tech or sharpen your existing toolset, and help support No Kid Hungry with your purchase.

expires_today.title: Hamble's Fright or Fight Halloween Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Spooky season calls for Humble’s Fright or Flight Halloween Bundle! Enjoy frightening savings on the hottest horror games, and help support the WDC with your purchase.

expires_today.title: Beyond Reality: Sci-Fi & Survival VR Collection
expires_today.long_description:
Blast off to faraway stars or stay home and hide from monsters in the woods with this bundle of sci-fi and horror (and sci-fi horror) VR games! expires_today.title: The Complete Java Developer Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Whether you’re a seasoned software developer or just getting the hang of a couple programming languages, this bundle of training resources has everything you need to master Java! expires_today.title: Unity Powerhouse Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Make video games that look like they took years to design—in no time at all! With this massive collection of tools and assets for Unity, you can fill your games with detail and atmosphere and have them ready to play before you know it. Build complete game worlds with ready-to-use characters, environments, biomes, and props. Create, experiment, prototype, and bring your ideas to life with a wide variety of production-ready Unity assets, many of which have never been featured in a Humble Bundle before! Get this huge bundle of assets for the price of your choosing, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 31, 2027.

expires_within_72h.long_description:
Get in touch with your sensitive side with this bundle of games from Serenity Forge! These emotional journeys will lead you through layered family dramas and post-apocalyptic deserts where humanity is the only thing we have left. Travel through a wasteland full of mutants in search of family in LISA: the Painful and LISA: The Joyful! Discover what immortality truly costs in the eerie RPG Death’s Gambit: Afterlife! Search through your childhood house to find your missing family in Gone Home! Exciting adventures and moving storytelling await in this bundle of the best from Serenity Forge. Grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!
